name: Mitochondrial Myopathy

criteria.description: Presence of progressive muscle weakness and exercise intolerance
Muscle biopsy showing ragged-red fibers or cytochrome c oxidase (COX) deficient fibers
Identification of pathogenic mitochondrial DNA or nuclear DNA mutations affecting mitochondrial function
Elevated blood or cerebrospinal fluid lactate levels at rest or after exercise
Brain MRI showing characteristic abnormalities such as basal ganglia lesions

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive muscle weakness plus either diagnostic muscle biopsy findings or confirmed pathogenic genetic mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires integration of clinical, histological, biochemical, and genetic data.

pathognomonic.notes: Indicative of mitochondrial proliferation in muscle fibers

pathognomonic.symptomName: Exercise intolerance due to muscle weakness
Elevated blood lactate at rest or post-exercise

laboratory: Elevated serum and CSF lactate and pyruvate
Abnormal oxidative phosphorylation enzyme activities in muscle biopsy
imaging: Brain MRI showing basal ganglia calcifications or stroke-like lesions
Muscle MRI showing selective muscle involvement
genetic: Pathogenic mitochondrial DNA mutations (e.g., MT-TL1 gene)
Nuclear gene mutations affecting mitochondrial function (e.g., POLG, TK2)
other: Muscle biopsy showing ragged-red fibers and COX-negative fibers

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of inflammatory infiltrates on muscle biopsy
Characteristic structural abnormalities on muscle biopsy

redFlags: Rapidly progressive muscle weakness with respiratory failure
Stroke-like episodes or acute neurological deterioration
references: DiMauro S, Schon EA. Mitochondrial respiratory-chain diseases. N Engl J Med. 2003 Jun 19;348(26):2656-68.
Parikh S, Goldstein A, Karaa A, et al. Diagnosis and management of mitochondrial disease: a consensus statement from the Mitochondrial Medicine Society. Genet Med. 2015 Sep;17(9):689-701.
Chinnery PF. Mitochondrial Disorders Overview. GeneReviews® [Internet]. 2020.
